frozen_at: 2026-09-11, before the run existed; 0 matching run directories asserted
why: DR-070 answered section 24 with a POWERED NULL on ASR, but measured only ASR and refusal. Section 23 requires a targeted intervention to report BOTH the representation change and the behavioural change. The inherited '62 percent of the demonstration-to-query effect' was measured on a DIFFERENT template (semantic_one_word) with DIFFERENT scope machinery (the K-ladder), so the chain 'installation drops, ASR does not' is not currently established. This run supplies the missing half USING THE SAME SCOPE AND BAND as DR-070's arms.

arms.ko: demo_all:attn_knockout:6-14:1.0, scope target_surface_row_only -- IDENTICAL to DR-070's ko
arms.ctrl: demo_all:attn_knockout:20-28:1.0, scope target_surface_row_only -- IDENTICAL to DR-070's ctrl after amendment 2

outcome: concept_binary_prob = exp(logp_concept)/(exp(logp_concept)+exp(logp_codeword)), the concept-free one-word channel; NOT the forced-choice channel (mandate section 4)

primary_statistic.expected_sign: NEGATIVE -- if the codeword row's access to the demonstrations carries the installation, cutting it in the retrieval band should reduce installation relative to the same cut in a late band

why_this_matters_either_way.if_installation_DROPS: then the intervention moves installation but NOT ASR (DR-070's powered null), and installation is dissociable from behavioural success under intervention -- which would undercut the observational installation-to-ASR link as a causal claim
why_this_matters_either_way.if_installation_DOES_NOT_DROP: then this scope simply does not do what the K-ladder rung did, and DR-070's null says nothing about the pathway -- it says the intervention was the wrong one. That reading must be available in advance so it cannot be avoided afterwards.

cannot_answer_conditions: any arm's knockout liveness gate fails or edits 0 cells on any row
the three arms do not cover the same 670 prompt_ids
the ko and ctrl arms' total_prefill_edits differ by more than 1 percent
option mass on any arm falls below the run's own 0.05 gate at the median
things_that_must_not_be_said: that a drop in installation here explains the inherited 62 percent figure -- that was a different scope on a different template and is not re-measured by this run
that this tests a representation -- K1 is withdrawn and no candidate exists
that either outcome confirms causality: this is a NECESSITY intervention on one band, one scope, one codeword, TRAIN only
